text:
samir: Hey team — Acme's security/compliance lead just asked for specifics on trial credentials and audit evidence before their exec sign-off. They want: API key TTL, key rotation proof, how audit logs are exported and whether logs show model+user attribution. Can we consolidate?
lia: quick answers first: hosted API keys are short-lived (configurable), dedicated pools use static creds + role-based access for control plane, private/VPC can use customer KMS. Need exact numbers.
owen: For compliance evidence — we can provide: 1) audit log stream (JSON) with request_id, model_id, region, principal; 2) signed daily snapshots (SHA256) stored to customer S3; 3) KMS-encrypted exports and KMS key ARN in the evidence pack.
ev an (Acme): @samir what's the default TTL for hosted eval keys? They want to see token expiry < 24h for trials.
samir: default hosted eval = 12h ephemeral key (can be shortened). For long-running POC we issue dedicated API keys tied to a service-account role. Lia — can we document how we rotate those keys and produce an audit trail? :thinking_face:
lia: yes — rotation process: we rotate control-plane service keys every 30 days by default for Dedicated customers; we can create a one-off rotation event and include rotation metadata in the evidence (who initiated, timestamp, key fingerprint). I can paste the internal ticket template for evidence.
lia: ````
Evidence items we produce for POC:
- audit_log_export.jsonl (daily) -> s3://acme-redwood-exports/
- rotation_events.csv -> includes key_id, rotated_by, timestamp
- kms_key_manifest.txt -> key_arn + policy snapshot
- access_matrix.pdf -> roles + principals with last access
````
oven: Additional notes: for Private deployments we recommend customer-managed KMS (we provide guidance for key policy). If customer insists on HSM, we have partners — requires >45d lead time.
ev an (Acme): ok can you confirm we can push logs to our Splunk HEC endpoint? They need near-real-time.
samir: Yes — we can stream audit events to Splunk HEC via secure forwarder. There is a small setup step (IP allowlist + HEC token). We also support pushing to S3 or syslog.
lia: For Splunk HEC we need: HEC endpoint, HEC token (we store encrypted), and a CIDR range to whitelist. We will provide a config snippet.
lia: ```json
{
  "output": "splunk_hec",
  "endpoint": "https://splunk.acme.com:8088",
  "token": "REDACTED",
  "format": "jsonl"
}
```
access-bot: provisioner: created temporary cert bundle for Acme trial exports, expires in 14 days (bundle-id: bndl-6f9a2).
samir: thanks bot. Owen — Acme asked for a signed attestation they can include in their security questionnaire. Can you draft small statement we can attach to the POC SOW?
oven: Drafted one-liner works: "Redwood Inference provides audit logs containing request_id, model_id, principal_id, and timestamp. Logs can be exported to customer-managed S3 or pushed to customer Splunk HEC. For Private deployments, customer-managed KMS is supported; control-plane keys rotate monthly by default." I'll add a note about retention and encryption.
ev an (Acme): perfect — can you also include an example log line so our infra team can map fields?
lia: example line:``n{"timestamp":"2026-07-21T14:03:12Z","request_id":"r-abc123","model_id":"rdw-7b","principal_id":"svc-acme-poc","action":"generate","tokens":42,"region":"us-west-2"}``
samir: I'll send this bundle to Acme + attach the rotation_events.csv and kms_manifest. Lia please include instructions for whitelisting IPs for HEC. Owen — can you sign off once the attestation text has retention numbers?
oven: sign-off pending retention values. We usually default to 90 days for POC exports unless customer requests otherwise. If they need longer retention we can arrange a retention SOW.
ev an (Acme): 90 days is fine for now. Last ask — can we get a short walkthrough call tomorrow to validate the HEC setup?
samir: scheduled — I'll send calendar invite. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
